# dadaia-workspace

> A local-first, spec-driven workspace that gives AI agents current context, a document-governed lifecycle, visible concurrency and anti-slop boundaries.

## What it is

<!-- derived-from: product-vision sha256:89dc2ce6898d -->

- [README](README.md): one workspace folder, projects in repos inside it, governance outside every repo; the unit is the context (main repo + associated repos); documents are the lifecycle; boundaries are mechanical.

## Install

<!-- derived-from: pypi-distribution sha256:7e18d9868790 -->
<!-- derived-from: workspace-init sha256:871519580ea1 -->

- [PyPI project](https://pypi.org/project/dadaia-workspace/): `pip install dadaia-workspace`, then `dadaia init <dir> --harness <name> [--repo <url>]`.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): one section per published version.

## The law

<!-- derived-from: agentic-entities sha256:2ab5fd5308c8 -->
<!-- derived-from: sdd-gate-v3 sha256:1c17b7e34596 -->

- [AGENTS.md](dadaia_workspace/public/data/AGENTS.md): the always-on law — the root map, projected once to the workspace root; every governed area carries its own scoped `AGENTS.md`.
- [Constitution](specs/constitution.md): the derivation law for personas, behaviors, rules and skills.

## Reference

<!-- derived-from: context-management sha256:160b285ee271 -->
<!-- derived-from: workspace-doctor sha256:06aea1796d92 -->

- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): the committed output of `dadaia help tree`.

- [Distribution](docs/distribution.md): how the public assets and the skills reach a harness.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): the longer walkthrough behind the quickstart.
- [Memory catalog](specs/memory/product/index.md): every product atom, its `tldr` and its path.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/dadaia-workspace): issues, releases and the full specs tree.

## The site

<!-- derived-from: product-vision sha256:89dc2ce6898d -->
<!-- derived-from: sdd-bug-backlog-governance sha256:753748a55aa3 -->

- [Documentation site](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/dadaia-workspace/): the published pages, served from `docs/` on `main`.
- [Landing](docs/index.md): the tagline and the three entry pages.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): install, init, bind, doctor, first backlog entry, first candidate.
- [Positioning](docs/positioning.md): product repos never carry agent config; one law governs many projects.
- [The bug loop](docs/bug-loop.md): register, RED, fix, resolve with evidence and lineage.
- [What the bug ledger taught](docs/bug-ledger-lessons.md): the closure-time counts and the fix-chain lesson — an additive fix breeds the next bug, a deletion-shaped fix ends the family.
